Feature: Patient Appointment Management

  As a healthcare professional, I want to manage patient appointments and consultations effectively.

  Scenario: Query and modify patient details
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When I query the patient details
  Then I should see the patient's information
  And I should be able to modify the patient's pin-code within the zone

  Scenario Outline: Modifying Patient Pin-Code
    | Patient ID | Pin-Code | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_pin_code> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_pin_code> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <missing_pin_code> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Query and enter patient details
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When I query the patient details
  Then I should see the patient's information
  And I should be able to enter details like Speciality, Symptoms, Appointment date

  Scenario Outline: Entering Patient Details
    | Patient ID | Speciality | Symptoms | Appointment Date | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_speciality> | <valid_symptoms> | <valid_appointment_date> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_speciality> | <valid_symptoms> | <valid_appointment_date> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_speciality> | <invalid_symptoms> | <valid_appointment_date> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_speciality> | <valid_symptoms> | <missing_appointment_date> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Create an appointment entry
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When I enter an appointment request for the next day
  Then an entry should be created in the Patient Appointment file

  Scenario Outline: Creating Appointment Entry
    | Patient ID | Appointment Date | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_appointment_date> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_appointment_date> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Doctor consultation requests
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When a doctor selects a consultation request
  Then the consultation request should be displayed

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Consultation Requests
    | Patient ID | Consultation Request | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_consultation_request> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_consultation_request> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Doctor diagnosis and prescription
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When a doctor diagnoses and prescribes
  Then the diagnosis and prescription should be recorded

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Diagnosis and Prescription
    | Patient ID | Diagnosis | Prescription | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_diagnosis> | <valid_prescription> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_diagnosis> | <valid_prescription> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_diagnosis> | <invalid_prescription> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Chemist prescription and medicines
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When a chemist prescribes medicines
  Then the medicines should be dispensed

  Scenario Outline: Chemist Prescription and Medicines
    | Patient ID | Prescription | Medicines | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_prescription> | <valid_medicines> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_prescription> | <valid_medicines> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_prescription> | <missing_medicines> | Invalid |

  Scenario: Lab prescription and lab tests
  Given a valid patient ID within the zone
  When a lab prescribes lab tests
    Then the lab tests should be noted and the prescription should be marked

  Scenario Outline: Lab Prescription and Lab Tests
    | Patient ID | Prescription | Lab Tests | Expected Result |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_prescription> | <valid_lab_tests> | Valid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <invalid_prescription> | <valid_lab_tests> | Invalid |
    | <valid_patient_id> | <valid_prescription> | <missing_lab_tests> | Invalid |
